title: Source registry
description: content/sources/sources.json: documents cited by id (sourceId / sourceIds) from facts, battles, phases, plans and what-ifs. Added in Phase 0; PLAN.md uses ids like "csi-cowpens-staff-ride" but didn't say where they live.

localFile.description: Path to a downloaded copy inside /sources, e.g. sources/cowpens-staff-ride.pdf. The check warns if it's missing.

license.description: public-domain: may redraw maps. copyrighted-link-only: link to it, never embed or trace (e.g. American Battlefield Trust maps). copyrighted-facts-only: use facts, paraphrased; no copying.
